description: This file defines an abstract class 'VideoFrameBuffer' in the 'cuttlefish::webrtc_streaming' namespace, representing a buffer for video frames with methods to access frame dimensions, strides, data pointers, and data sizes.

classes.name: VideoFrameBuffer
classes.description: An abstract interface for a video frame buffer providing methods to access frame properties and data.

methods.name: width
methods.description: Returns the width of the video frame.

methods.name: height
methods.description: Returns the height of the video frame.

methods.name: StrideY
methods.description: Returns the stride (bytes per row) for the Y plane.

methods.name: StrideU
methods.description: Returns the stride for the U plane.

methods.name: StrideV
methods.description: Returns the stride for the V plane.

methods.name: DataY
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the Y plane data.

methods.name: DataU
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the U plane data.

methods.name: DataV
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the V plane data.

methods.name: DataSizeY
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the Y plane data.

methods.name: DataSizeU
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the U plane data.

methods.name: DataSizeV
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the V plane data.
